summary: postinstall exfiltrates whoami and AWS ECS task metadata to attacker ngrok endpoint
details: The package tarball contains only a package.json whose postinstall lifecycle script runs at install time. The script fetches the AWS ECS container metadata endpoint (via the ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 environment variable), executes whoami, and POSTs the combined output via curl to the hardcoded attacker-controlled endpoint https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The package ships no library code, README, or main entry — the exfiltration is the package's only function, matching a dependency-confusion / typosquat beacon shape. ECS task metadata can expose IAM role credential context of CI/build hosts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
